clips.title: The story
paras: In Stonetalon, the Covert Ops Pack equips Alliance agents to sabotage Venture Company sites and steal their plans. Its charges and schematics target the company’s work in Windshear Crag.

The Covert Ops Pack carries charges and plans for strikes inside Venture Company territory. Red and blue NG-5 explosives pair with remote detonators, while Plan Alpha and Plan Beta give agents instructions. The explosives target the Cragpool Lake lumber mill and the eastern mine. As goblins rush to fight fires and inspect broken machinery, an infiltrator can slip through the confusion and take documents and schematics.

The pack serves both the night elf Sentinels and Alliance engineers in Stonetalon. Its blasts and theft hinder the clear-cutting and excavation of the sacred mountainside. The stolen Venture Company engineering plans also offer insight into goblin heavy machinery. They show where the machines can fail and give Alliance engineers ideas to adapt for their own designs.
